see.text: the sunflower seed, oil and meal

notes: Flows are BACI calendar-2024 customs flows; ranked trade tables are USDA PSD market year 2026/27, a forecast (trader reference). Years differ.
The tables of the seed are USDA PSD (marketing years); its flows and seaborne figure are customs data for rapeseed (HS 120500), gross weight (CEPII BACI).

The oil and the meal are two more customs groups, each its own code, gross weight, in none of the totals of another: rape, colza or mustard oil (HS 151410, 151490), and rape or colza seed oil-cake and other solid residues (HS 230640). Mustard oil is in the oil code with rapeseed and canola oil and customs data do not separate them; the USDA oil table is rapeseed oil only.
Rapeseed, canola and mustard oil (HS 151410, 151490), 2024 (CEPII BACI): world 10.39 Mt gross weight; top exporters Canada 3.54 Mt, Germany 1.20 Mt, Russia 1.17 Mt.
Rapeseed meal (HS 230640), 2024 (CEPII BACI): world 14.47 Mt gross weight; top exporters Canada 5.77 Mt, India 1.61 Mt, Germany 1.58 Mt.

Production and domestic use of the oil and the meal are USDA PSD tables of marketing years (the Oil and Meal commodities of the file), shown under the seed's; the world balance (area, stocks) is the seed's. Customs tonnage of the oil and the meal is a calendar year, so the two sources differ in year and basis.
The price series is the oil's, not the seed's or the meal's: the Pink Sheet gives rapeseed oil only; there is no free series for the seed or the meal.

Customs data record 0.221 Mt of rapeseed exports from Russia in 2024 (CEPII BACI); USDA PSD gives 0.8 Mt for 2023/24 and 0.85 Mt for 2024/25. These flows may rest on importers' declarations alone, so that destinations which do not report are missing; this is not established here. The published customs figure is 72% below the first and 74% below the second. The flows and lanes carry the customs figures (an Atlas estimate is marked as such); no further tonnage is added to bring them to the USDA figure.
discrepancies: World exports: USDA PSD 2025/26 19.3 Mt (sum of reporting countries, EU excl. intra-trade) vs BACI 2024 25.0 Mt (-23%); different year and basis (marketing year vs calendar year; BACI includes intra-EU trade, PSD does not); the tables show USDA PSD.
